ei.title: 2번: A Board Game from an Ancient Grave
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was wealthy. This is because board games were a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to provide the dead person with entertainment in the next world.

det.korean: play → playing (spend time + V-ing: ~하며 시간을 보내다)
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞 'spend time(시간을 보내다)' 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 해요. 그래서 play를 playing으로 바꿔야 합니다. 'spend time playing'은 '~하며 시간을 보내다'라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: spend time + V-ing = ~하며 시간을 보내다 → play는 playing으로

questions.passage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was wealthy. This is because board games were a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to provide the dead person with entertainment in the next world.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 핵심: 무덤 속 보드게임 → 죽은 이의 부·사회적 지위를 나타냄
det.analysis:
① 장례 절차 자체가 아니라 특정 부장품에 초점
② 무덤 속 보드게임이 죽은 이의 부와 사회적 지위를 알려줌 ←정답
③ 게임 규칙·방법은 언급 없음
④ 경제·무역 발전은 언급 없음
det.tip: board game = indication of wealth + symbol of status → 죽은 이의 지위

ch: 고대 노르웨이의 장례 절차와 매장 방식
무덤에서 발견된 보드게임이 알려주는 죽은 이의 사회적 지위
고대 보드게임의 다양한 규칙과 놀이 방법
철기 시대 노르웨이의 경제와 무역 발전

questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지: 부장품(보드게임)은 죽은 이의 지위 + 사후 세계 믿음을 보여줌
det.analysis:

② 가장 오래된 게임이라는 언급 없음
③ 부장품은 죽은 이의 신분과 사후 세계에 대한 믿음을 반영 ←정답
④ 교육 vs 부의 우열은 본문 논점이 아님
det.tip: symbol of status + purpose = entertainment in the next world → 신분 + 사후 믿음

ch: 보드게임은 고대에 오직 오락을 위한 도구였다.
고고학자들은 노르웨이에서 가장 오래된 보드게임을 발견했다.
무덤 속 부장품은 죽은 이의 신분과 사후 세계에 대한 믿음을 반영한다.
고대 문명에서는 교육이 부보다 더 중요하게 여겨졌다.
